title: Naidu, Chouhan highlight role of SHGs in promoting women empowerment
description: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan says 3.5 crore women, of the targeted 6 crore, have achieved the target of ₹1 lakh annual income, with A.P. accounting for 23 lakh of them; State govt. will provide permanent spaces for SARAS Mela in the city, says Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu
